title: Gateway SDK options
responsibility: Builds isolated SDK options for a local Claude gateway session.

inputs.name: gatewayOptions.session
inputs.description: Session whose abort controller should control the SDK request.

outputs.name: gatewayOptions
outputs.description: SDK options using a copied environment with Anthropic and Claude provider overrides removed, no built-in tools or setting sources, no persistent session, Opus 5.5 with xhigh effort, dontAsk mode and /tmp working directory. The executable comes from HARNESS_CLAUDE_EXECUTABLE or the home-local Claude binary.
